verdict.rationale: Antigravity is a VSCode-fork IDE with a built-in chat/agent panel offering tab autocompletion, natural language commands, and a context-aware conversational agent (docs-6), a model selector inside the conversation prompt box (docs-16), and Planning/Artifact review flows that keep the conversation contextual to the codebase (docs-24, docs-25); community confirms it functions as a chat-based VSCode-like IDE (comm-1). Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of chat response quality/latency, and some hands-on reports call the harness/IDE experience subpar (comm-8), which caps confidence though it doesn't concretely negate the core in-IDE chat capability.
